subject: Insurance
title: The Death of Annual Policies
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Death of Annual Policies usable.

hook.text: Cuvva sells car insurance by the hour. Need to borrow a friend's car for 2 hours? Tap the app and pay £5.

buildup.text: Traditional annual policies assume you need coverage 365 days. But millions of people only drive occasionally.

discovery.text: On-demand insurance activates and deactivates coverage instantly. You're insured only when you need to be.

twist.text: On-demand pricing can cost more per hour than annual rates. Convenience carries a premium.

climax.text: Flexible coverage fragments the risk pool. Annual policies spread risk broadly; hourly policies isolate it.

punchline.text: £5 for 2 hours of car insurance. Coverage on demand, by the tap.

quiz.question: What is a potential downside of on-demand insurance?
options: Per-hour costs can exceed annual policy rates for frequent users
